content.description: Octane provides engineering teams with an in-house, trainable AI security researcher. Through a one-click GitHub integration, Octane continuously analyzes source code across the software development lifecycle, learning from your codebase to improve accuracy. Over time, the models adapt to the project, reducing noise and sharpening signals to surface security concerns early and help teams address risks more efficiently.
